name: Exercise GREY LANTERN
disclaimer: Fictional training scenario for decision-making education. All places, groups and events are invented.
mission: Blue team secures a crossing over the Kestrel river so a simulated relief convoy can reach the relief point at E1 by T+15:00.
intent: The convoy crosses safely by T+15:00. Avoid an unnecessary confrontation. If Bridge B-2 is unusable, use Ford F-1 even though it is slower.

GTL.title: Ground Team Lead
GTL.brief: You lead Blue team on the ground and make the team's final calls. You rely on the others for most of your picture.

ISR.title: Air / ISR Monitor
ISR.brief: You watch the simulated UAV and observation post feeds. You see the ground from above, but your feed can go stale or offline.

EW.title: Cyber / EW Officer
EW.brief: You watch the spectrum and the team's networks. You may spot jamming or spoofed traffic before anyone else does.

COMMS.title: Comms Coordinator
COMMS.brief: You keep the team talking. Anyone can route messages through your relay, which gets past jamming, but every relayed message is transmitted from your position.

questions.text: Is Bridge B-2 usable right now?
Is Ford F-1 passable for the convoy?

injects.text: Bridge B-2 clear. No activity observed on or near the bridge.

contradiction.text: Vehicles seen parked at the north end of Bridge B-2.

injects.text: Unidentified group of about 6 moving south toward Bridge B-2.

contradiction.text: No movement seen around C3 in the last 10 minutes.

injects.note: Simulated EW activity starts degrading the ground team's radio net

injects.text: Unusual emissions near C3. Possible jamming and direction-finding activity.

injects.note: Opposing direction finding becomes active: heavy radio use can now give a position away

injects.prompt: Blue team is ready to move. Advance to Bridge B-2 now?

options.label: Request verification from ISR before moving

injects.question: Q1

injects.prompt: The Ground Team Lead has stopped acknowledging traffic. What do you do with critical updates?

options.label: Send them through the relay or by runner

injects.text: Patrol-2's radio net shows signs of spoofed traffic since about T+03:00.
